column_semantics: The schedule presents Interest as separate Ref. Rate, Cash, and PIK columns. A printed Cash percentage is the cash spread/rate component; any printed PIK percentage is separately stated and additive, not included in the Cash column.

citations.where: Schedule of Investments, March 31, 2026, table 14 rows 1-2; same header repeated across schedule tables 9-21

rationale: The filing does not use a single all-in rate column. It places rate information under an Interest heading with separate Ref. Rate, Cash, and PIK columns, and actual PIK-bearing positions show distinct percentages in the Cash and PIK columns. Therefore the stated position-level cash rate/spread excludes PIK when PIK is shown separately.
